The question probes practical CAPA design for supply-chain compromises in containerized environments, emphasizing data models, lifecycle, and measurable containment.

## Key Concepts
- CAPA data model representing incidents, evidence, remediation, tenants, and artifacts
- Image provenance, SBOMs, and artifact signing in CI/CD
- Region-aware metrics: MTTR, recurrence rate, false positives
- RCA templates, canary rollout strategies, and linked logs/traces

}
